en.headline: Four women arrested for offering makeup and tour services on visitor visas
en.dek: Immigration officers say the suspects, aged 20 to 31, advertised one-stop photography, styling and guide packages on social media and were caught while providing the services.
body: The Immigration Department said on Monday it had arrested four women, aged between 20 and 31, who entered Hong Kong as visitors and were suspected of providing makeup, photography and tour-guide services in breach of their conditions of stay.

One of the women worked as a makeup artist charging about HK$700 per session; the other three offered combined photography and guiding services priced between HK$400 and HK$600. They operated personal accounts on social platforms, required deposits and advertised package itineraries that included theme parks, equipment rental and styling advice.

Officers posed as customers, booked the services and made the arrests while the women were providing them. Photographic equipment and props were seized. The department said further arrests were not ruled out and urged the public not to engage unlicensed service providers.

zh.headline: 入境處拘四名訪客女子涉提供化妝拍攝導遊服務
zh.dek: 四名20至31歲女子以訪客身份來港，涉嫌在社交平台招徠一條龍化妝、攝影及導遊服務，被控違反逗留條件。
body: 入境處周一表示，昨日及今日共拘捕四名以訪客身份來港的女子，年齡介乎20至31歲，她們涉嫌提供化妝、拍攝及導遊服務，違反逗留條件。
其中一人為化妝師，聲稱單次收費約700港元；其餘三人兼做攝影師及導遊，收費介乎400至600元。她們在社交平台經營個人帳戶，以廉價收費招徠，要求收取訂金，並聲稱提供主題樂園行程規劃、攝影器材租用及造型指導等一條龍服務。
調查人員早前喬裝顧客預訂服務，在她們來港提供服務時拘捕，並檢獲攝影器材及道具。入境處不排除有更多人被捕，並呼籲市民慎選服務，避免向不明來源購買。
